item.title: SASSA SRD Grant June 2026: Still R370, Extended to March 2027
item.description: The SRD grant stays at R370 for June 2026 — no increase from the 2026 Budget, but extended to March 2027. Payment dates, eligibility, and how to check your status.

item.title: South African E-Wallets Help SRD Recipients Receive Funds
item.description: In South Africa, clients who rely on receiving funds through the Cash Send service are being urged to collect their funds as soon as they receive an SMS with a voucher number for their chosen bank. But what if clients have been approved for COVID-19 SRD but no payment date is indicated on their January status or earlier months, and have selected to be paid through the Postbank or Cashsend? In this case, they are urged to open bank accounts and upload them on the system to fast-track payments.
